articles.text: WÁNG DÀNIÁN: Qǐngwèn, nǐ shi nǎrde rén?
WÁNG DÀNIÁN: May I ask, where are you from?
ĀNDÉSĒN FŪREN: Wǒ shi Dézhōu rén. Nǐ ne?
MRS. ANDERSON: I'm from Texas. And you?
WÁNG DÀNIÁN: Wǒ lǎojiā zài Shāndōng. Nǐ àiren yě shi Dézhōu rén ma?
WÁNG DÀNIÁN: My family is from Shāndōng. Is your husband from Texas too?
ĀNDÉSĒN FŪREN: Bú shi, tā yě bú shi Dézhōu rén. Tā shi Jiānádà rén.
MRS. ANDERSON: No, he isn't from Texas either. He's Canadian.
WÁNG DÀNIÁN: Tā xiànzài zài nǎr?
WÁNG DÀNIÁN: Where is he now?
ĀNDÉSĒN FŪREN: Tā xiànzài zài Jiānádà. Qǐngwèn, Qīngdǎo zài nǎr?
MRS. ANDERSON: He's in Canada now. May I ask, where is Qīngdǎo?
WÁNG DÀNIÁN: Qīngdǎo zài Shāndōng. Wǒ lǎojiā yě zài Shāndōng.
WÁNG DÀNIÁN: Qīngdǎo is in Shāndōng. My family is from Shāndōng too.
MRS. ANDERSON: Thank you, thank you.
